issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按 92f 推断，B 式（选中高亮）整段没渲染出来
降格后长出的内容是 5 条灰色骨架条 + 一张 2px 灰边空白卡，像未完成的线框
#ececea 纯色平铺 + Helvetica 800，标题与背景都缺质感
标题 20f 飞行 810px 全程锐利，没有速度感；选中高亮是半透明蓝块，缺少"可编辑文本"的暗示
changes: 补 TITLE_DEMOTE_TO_LABEL_DURATION = 196f（A 92f + B 104f），两式完整串播
内容区换成出版级假内容：发丝分隔线 + 4 行真实正文 + 列表卡（序号、进度条、元信息、状态 chip），生长保持 0.16 错峰与宽 0.35→1，改为裁切揭开不压扁字
柔光 Backdrop + 系统 SF 栈 700、-0.04em 字距，显影附 1.03→1 轻收
降格飞行按位置差分速度加方向性运动模糊（≤10px，静止为 0），单条 inOut(cubic) 曲线不变
B 式选区改系统选区蓝 + 跟随右缘的 2px 插入光标；串播白闪改暖白 #fbfaf7
issuesEn: No exported duration, so the workbench guessed 92f and variant B (selection highlight) never rendered
The content that grew in after the demote was five grey skeleton bars and an empty 2px-bordered card, like an unfinished wireframe
Flat #ececea fill with Helvetica 800; neither the title nor the background had any finish
The 810px, 20f flight stayed razor sharp with no sense of speed; the selection was a plain translucent blue block with no 'editable text' cue
changesEn: Added TITLE_DEMOTE_TO_LABEL_DURATION = 196f (A 92f + B 104f) so both variants play in full

Content is now publication-grade: a hairline rule, four lines of real body copy and a list card (index, progress bar, meta, status chip); growth keeps the 0.16 stagger and 0.35→1 width, now as a clip reveal so text never squashes
Soft-light Backdrop, SF system stack at 700 with -0.04em tracking, and a 1.03→1 settle on reveal
Directional motion blur from the positional speed during the demote flight (≤10px, zero at rest); the single inOut(cubic) curve is unchanged
Variant B uses system selection blue plus a 2px caret riding the selection edge; the hand-off flash is warm white #fbfaf7
